meta_description:
2,144 likes, 20 comments - unicef on October 29, 2026: "1 billion.

That’s the number of doses of polio vaccines UNICEF procures and delivers around the world every year.

Ending polio and helping children survive and thrive means making sure they have access to vaccines and are protected against preventable diseases.

We have the knowledge and tools to #EndPolio forever. Now, more than ever, we must invest to realize every child’s right to health.

Link in bio to learn more.
#WorldPolioDay".
